newsitem.title: PERU: Peru prime minister rules out Camet resignation.
newsitem.headline: Peru prime minister rules out Camet resignation.

text.p: Peru's Prime Minister Alberto Pandolfi ruled out the resignation of Economy Minister Jorge Camet from the government.
Pandolfi said in a television interview late Sunday there was no substance to the rumors that Camet was mulling a departure.
He added that the minister enjoyed both prestige in financial circles abroad and popularity at home.

Camet, who has served in President Alberto Fujimori's government for nearly four years, said in a recent interview with Reuters Television that he plans to remain in office one more year. But he has been dogged recently by rumors in Peruvian media of a resignation or dismissal.
